name: AICTE Pragati Scholarship Scheme for Girl Students (Diploma)
provider: All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE), Government of India
unchecked_criteria: Must be admitted to the first year of a diploma course in an AICTE-approved institution, or to the second year through lateral entry
Only a maximum of two girl children per family are eligible
The gap between passing the qualifying exam and admission must not exceed two years
Must not receive any other financial assistance, scholarship or stipend during the course
benefit: Rs 50,000 per year for up to 3 years (2 years for lateral entry). No additional grant for hostel or medical charges.
documents: Family income certificate issued by State/UT Government
